title: Go-Bag Inventory Weekly Audit Time Trend
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gobag:inventory audit_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(audit_minutes) as avg_duration, max(audit_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst audit time for go-bag inventory events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture audit_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average audit time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether go-bag inventory tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
